name: Pillar 3a withdrawal of CHF 150,000 at 60, Zurich, without work
workings: Zurich: 1/20 × 150,000 = 7,500, taxed at 0.133%, below the 2% minimum: simple 3,000; cantonal 2,850, communal 3,570.
Without work at 60, AHV contributions without work are due: no wealth in the year's accounts (the 3a payout isn't wealth), so the minimum CHF 530 + 5% admin costs = 556.50.
The year counts as an AHV year: 12 months, credited with the minimum contribution's income 530 × 0.81 / 0.087 = 4,934.4828.
Gross-up for 100,000 net from a 3a account, alone in the year: Zurich's 2% minimum binds up to 428,000, so S − federal(S)/5 − 4.28% × S = 100,000 gives S = 105,102.6356.
